title: cli.user_listener.UserRequest
description:
One outbound user request, as broadcast to every connected user
stream.

agent_arguments.description: The originating caller's agent identity, from its scope.

details.description: Arbitrary request payload, opaque to the daemon.

id.description: The daemon-minted request id — the reply routing key.

key.description:
Caller-chosen discriminator (e.g. `"AskUserQuestion"`) — how a
user surface decides what UI the `details` drive.

plugin_owner.description:
The PLUGIN that originated the request — daemon-authored
(unspoofable; stamped by `plugins run`), absent when the
caller wasn't a plugin.
